from tools import search_hotels, search_attractions, filter_hotels, filter_attractions, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached results
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")
attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Filter hotels based on amenities (gym and wifi)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, gym_present=True, free_wifi_included=True)

# Filter attractions based on type (Art) and name (Saguaro National Park)
filtered_attractions = filter_attractions(prior_results=attractions, type=["Art"], attraction_name=["Saguaro National Park"])

# Save the filtered results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_attractions", value=filtered_attractions)

# Find the nearest attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_results = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, attractions=filtered_attractions, groupBy="hotel")

# Save the nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_results", value=nearest_results)
